annotations.title: Validate EU/XI B2B VAT ID & VIES Reverse-Charge State

description: Normalize EU-27 and Northern Ireland (XI) B2B VAT identifiers (including mandatory Greece ISO-3166 GR to EL prefix normalization) and evaluate cross-border 0% VAT reverse-charge eligibility, VIES consultation evidence, or MS_UNAVAILABLE circuit-breaker fulfillment hold actions. Read-only and non-destructive; supports deterministic simulation modes ('VALID', 'INVALID', 'MS_UNAVAILABLE') or real-time European Commission VIES SOAP/REST lookup ('LIVE'). Returns structuredContent containing ok, mode, statelessEphemeralAudit, simulatedViesLookup, tenantId, normalizedVat, reverseChargeEligible, and viesDecision (status, action, zeroRateAllowed, consultationId). Use this tool for EU/XI VAT tax compliance; use revclamp_reconcile_b2b_net_terms for wholesale Net-15/30/60 deposit and credit-note accounting.

buyerVatId.description: Required buyer EU or Northern Ireland VAT registration number to normalize and validate (e.g. 'DE123456789', 'GR123456789', 'NL123456789B01', 'XI123456789', max 40 chars).

consultationNumber.description: Optional VIES requester consultation reference number (e.g. 'WAPIAAAAW998877', max 64 chars) to attach to deterministic 'VALID' mode tax audit records.

demo.description: Optional simulation flag (boolean) for deterministic VIES gateway preset evaluation.

sellerCountry.description: Two-letter EU-27 or XI member state prefix of the merchant's dispatch warehouse (e.g. 'DE', 'NL', 'FR', 'EL', 'XI'; 'GR' is automatically normalized to 'EL'; default: 'DE').

supplyType.description: Cross-border transaction supply category: 'GOODS' (Directive 2006/112/EC Art. 138(1) intra-Community supply, default; permitted for Northern Ireland XI under Windsor Framework) or 'SERVICES' (Directive 2006/112/EC Art. 196 B2B reverse charge; excluded from EU VIES for Northern Ireland XI).

viesMode.description: VIES evaluation mode: 'FORMAT_ONLY' (deterministic EU/XI syntax validation without consultation; local engine default), 'VALID' (deterministic active VAT simulation; cloud endpoint default), 'INVALID' (deterministic rejected VAT simulation), 'MS_UNAVAILABLE' or 'GLOBAL_MAX_CONCURRENT_REQ' (deterministic member-state outage circuit-breaker simulation), or 'LIVE' (real-time European Commission VIES lookup).
